text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...No good... At this rate, I'll... Bright 
will...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Working hard as always, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, push no further. ...The fear you 
harbor within is not something you can 
cast off merely by getting desperate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! I-I'm not scared or anything...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Don't underestimate me. Just how long do 
you think I've been watching you run?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Why the rush?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ……I can't stop shaking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I crossed that finish line at 
the Oka Sho... Ever since I heard that 
roar from the stands... always...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, I could tell that so many 
voices... so many eyes... were turned 
toward me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And then, suddenly... memories of the 
past... flashed through my mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The me who used to run while crying... No 
matter what, she just... overlaps with the 
me of today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then... that scene keeps 
flashing before my eyes... And every time 
it does, my body trembles—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I can't compete in the 
Oaks...! I... finally... made it this far, 
and yet...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm terrified...! Of reverting back to my 
old self... in front of everyone... in 
front of Bright...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Is that really true?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is it because you'll revert to your old 
self? Because you can't fight in the Oaks 
if you're trembling?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that is terrifying as well. 
However, what you truly fear is something 
else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What I am truly... afraid of...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I recognize that fear. Because back 
during the Oaks, I felt the exact same 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Y-You too, Senpai...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As the challenge of the Oaks drew near, 
something began to weigh heavily upon my 
mind and body."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That was— the "ideal" she longed to reach 
no matter what. The "dream" of a 
mother-daughter double crown that everyone 
hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Every time I thought I couldn't afford to 
lose, I felt terror. Terror of the 
possibility that I might betray my 
"ideals" and my "dreams."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...However, one day, out of the blue, the 
way I viewed this fear changed."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I pondered where the root of that fear 
lay... And then, it hit me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The reason I am able to feel such fear is 
because there are those who place their 
expectations on me—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And... it is because I myself continue to 
challenge myself—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let me ask you once more, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why do you fear? What is it that you truly 
fear?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I see... What I was afraid of was—)

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Mejiro Dober--!! Good 
luck in the Oaks too--!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool~!! I'm definitely going 
to watch the Oaks too, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Now then~, once again—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Would you take my hand, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(To betray everyone, Bright, and all their 
expectations...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But that was only because there was 
someone who believed in me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(It's only because I'm aiming for greater 
heights right now...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. The look on your face says it all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The root of your fear is, conversely, what 
has elevated you this far.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you ever lose faith in yourself and 
feel like stopping in your tracks, listen 
to the words of those who believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You can surely do it. Because you have 
Ryan, Bright, myself, and—all of us who 
believe in you—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Our senpais and... the Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to your run in the 
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest. I haven't stopped 
trembling yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Even knowing what this trembling is, it's 
still scary... But even so—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I swear I'll run the Oaks all the way to 
the end. For the sake of everyone counting 
on me...!
choice_data_list: Let me carry that fear with you.
Let me shoulder that fear with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh—

—I've made up my mind. I will believe in 
her more than anyone, and support her more 
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Why do you always have to phrase things 
like that? Honestly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Why do you go so far for me...? 
Still—

Her following words dissolved into the 
twilight, spoken so softly that I couldn't 
make them out.

Her following words dissolved into the 
twilight, spoken so softly that I couldn't 
make them out.

However, a powerful light burned in her 
eyes, convincing me that her heart was now 
just fine—
